label: NPC Tracker
title: Saves <npc> dossiers from AI replies into the chat lorebook
message:
/* NPC Tracker v1
   Reads <npc>...</npc> blocks from the latest AI message and saves each one
   to this chat's lorebook. New NPCs get a new entry; blocks for existing NPCs
   are merged field by field, so a partial update never erases older details.
   Also keeps an always-on "NPC Roster" entry listing every saved NPC.
*|
/parser-flag STRICT_ESCAPING on |
/parser-flag REPLACE_GETVAR on |
/messages names=off {{lastMessageId}} |
/let key=msg {{pipe}} |
/match pattern="/<npc[^>]*>\s*([^]*?)\s*<\/npc>/gi" {{var::msg}} |
/let key=matches {{pipe}} |
/len {{var::matches}} |
/let key=count {{pipe}} ||
/if left={{var::count}} rule=lt right=1 {: /abort quiet=true :} ||

/getchatbook |
/let key=book {{pipe}} |

/* Save or merge one dossier block *|
/let key=saveNpc {: block=
    /match pattern="/^[*_ -]*Name[*_]*:[*_ ]*(.+?)[*_ ]*$/mi" {{var::block}} |
    /let key=nameMatch {{pipe}} ||
    /if left="#{{var::nameMatch}}" rule=eq right="#" {: /break :} ||
    /var key=nameMatch index=1 |
    /let key=name {{pipe}} |

    /* look for an existing entry titled exactly "NPC: <name>" *|
    /let key=target new |
    /findentry file={{var::book}} field=comment NPC: {{var::name}} |
    /let key=found {{pipe}} |
    /if left="#{{var::found}}" rule=neq right="#" {:
        /getentryfield file={{var::book}} field=comment {{var::found}} |
        /if left={{pipe}} rule=eq right="NPC: {{var::name}}" {: /var key=target {{var::found}} :}
    :} |

    /pass [NPC dossier: keep this character consistent with what is written here]{{newline}}{{var::block}} |
    /let key=content {{pipe}} |
    /let key=verb saved ||
    /if left={{var::target}} rule=eq right=new
        else={:
            /* merge: each "Field: value" line replaces the same field, new fields are appended *|
            /var key=verb updated |
            /getentryfield file={{var::book}} field=content {{var::target}} |
            /var key=content {{pipe}} |
            /match pattern="/^[*_ -]*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z /-]{0,30}?)[*_]*:[*_ ]*(.+?)[*_ ]*$/gm" {{var::block}} |
            /let key=lines {{pipe}} |
            /len {{var::lines}} |
            /times {{pipe}} {:
                /var key=lines index={{timesIndex}} |
                /let key=ln {{pipe}} ||
                /var key=ln index=0 |
                /let key=fullLine {{pipe}} ||
                /var key=ln index=1 |
                /let key=field {{pipe}} |
                /test pattern="/^[*_ -]*{{var::field}}[*_]*:/mi" {{var::content}} |
                /if left={{pipe}} rule=eq right=true
                    else={: /var key=content {{var::content}}{{newline}}{{var::fullLine}} :}
                    {:
                        /replace mode=regex pattern="/^[*_ -]*{{var::field}}[*_]*:.*$/mi" replacer={{var::fullLine}} {{var::content}} |
                        /var key=content {{pipe}}
                    :}
            :}
        :}
        {:
            /createentry file={{var::book}} key="NPC: {{var::name}}" |
            /var key=target {{pipe}}
        :} ||

    /* keywords: the name plus everything on the Keys line *|
    /match pattern="/^[*_ -]*Keys[*_]*:[*_ ]*(.+?)[*_ ]*$/mi" {{var::content}} |
    /let key=keyMatch {{pipe}} |
    /let key=keys {{var::name}} ||
    /if left="#{{var::keyMatch}}" rule=neq right="#" {:
        /var key=keyMatch index=1 |
        /var key=keys {{var::name}}, {{pipe}}
    :} ||

    /* role, for the roster *|
    /match pattern="/^[*_ -]*Role[*_]*:[*_ ]*(.+?)[*_ ]*$/mi" {{var::content}} |
    /let key=roleMatch {{pipe}} |
    /let key=role (role not stated) ||
    /if left="#{{var::roleMatch}}" rule=neq right="#" {:
        /var key=roleMatch index=1 |
        /replace pattern="\"" replacer="'" {{pipe}} |
        /var key=role {{pipe}}
    :} ||

    /setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::target}} field=comment NPC: {{var::name}} ||
    /setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::target}} field=key {{var::keys}} ||
    /setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::target}} field=content {{var::content}} ||
    /setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::target}} field=excludeRecursion true ||
    /setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::target}} field=sticky 4 ||
    /setvar key=npcRoster index="{{var::name}}" {{var::role}} ||
    /echo title="NPC Tracker" NPC {{var::verb}}: {{var::name}}
:} |

/* Process every block in the message *|
/times {{var::count}} {:
    /var key=matches index={{timesIndex}} |
    /let key=pair {{pipe}} ||
    /var key=pair index=1 |
    /let key=blk {{pipe}} ||
    /:saveNpc block={{var::blk}}
:} ||

/* Rebuild the always-on roster entry *|
/getvar npcRoster |
/replace mode=regex pattern="/\"([^\"]*)\":\"([^\"]*)\",?/g" replacer="- $1: $2{{newline}}" {{pipe}} |
/replace mode=regex pattern="/^./" replacer="" {{pipe}} |
/replace mode=regex pattern="/.$/" replacer="" {{pipe}} |
/let key=roster {{pipe}} |
/let key=rosterUid new |
/findentry file={{var::book}} field=comment NPC Roster |
/let key=foundRoster {{pipe}} |
/if left="#{{var::foundRoster}}" rule=neq right="#" {:
    /getentryfield file={{var::book}} field=comment {{var::foundRoster}} |
    /if left={{pipe}} rule=eq right="NPC Roster" {: /var key=rosterUid {{var::foundRoster}} :}
:} ||
/if left={{var::rosterUid}} rule=eq right=new {:
    /createentry file={{var::book}} key="NPC Roster" |
    /var key=rosterUid {{pipe}}
:} ||
/setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::rosterUid}} field=constant true ||
/setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::rosterUid}} field=preventRecursion true ||
/setentryfield file={{var::book}} uid={{var::rosterUid}} field=content [Recurring NPCs already established in this story. Reuse them instead of inventing new people for the same roles. Their full details appear when they are mentioned.]{{newline}}{{var::roster}}
